options.content: JVM whitebox for the Kotlin reports service (RFC-0001 D2 JVM showcase). The **GC sawtooth** exhibit is live as of Phase 6 PR-2: the report engine's bursty Apache POI / PDF allocation drives the Heap and GC panels below -- watch `Heap Used` climb between collections and drop on each GC while a report generates. The report-job row (jobs by status, duration p95, in-flight, artifact throughput) reads the service's custom Micrometer meters. All panels read the Prometheus datasource; `reports` is an opt-in compose profile, so panels show *No data* when it is not up (expected, RFC-0001 D10).

panels.title: Service Up
panels.description: up{job="reports"} -- Prometheus scrape health (observability/prometheus.yml `reports` job). 0/down when the `reports` compose profile is not running (RFC-0001 D10 graceful degradation), 1 while it is scraped successfully.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: process_uptime_seconds -- time since the JVM started. The JVM's startup time (relative to the Go/Rust services) is itself part of the D2 lesson.

panels.title: Live Threads
panels.description: jvm_threads_live_threads -- current live thread count (daemon + non-daemon). Virtual threads are enabled (spring.threads.virtual) and report jobs run on a small bounded dispatcher, so platform-thread growth under the report workload stays modest.

panels.title: Heap Used
panels.description: sum(jvm_memory_used_bytes{area="heap"}) -- current heap occupancy across all pools. The sawtooth between GC cycles is the report engine's bursty POI/PDF allocation made visible (RFC-0001 D2).

panels.title: JVM Heap: Used vs Committed
panels.description: sum by state of jvm_memory_used_bytes / jvm_memory_committed_bytes for area="heap". Used tracks live objects; committed is what the OS has handed the heap. The gap and the used-line sawtooth are the GC-visibility exhibit (RFC-0001 D2), driven by the report engine's bursty allocation during generation.

panels.title: JVM Non-Heap Used
panels.description: sum(jvm_memory_used_bytes{area="nonheap"}) -- metaspace, code cache, etc. Grows during class loading at startup, then flattens -- a contrast to the heap's sawtooth.

panels.title: GC Pause Rate by Action
panels.description: sum(rate(jvm_gc_pause_seconds_count[5m])) by (action) -- how often GC pauses happen, split by action (end of minor/major GC). Near-flat when idle; the report engine's allocation bursts drive it up -- the counterpart to the heap sawtooth.

panels.title: GC Time Spent by Action
panels.description: sum(rate(jvm_gc_pause_seconds_sum[5m])) by (action) -- seconds spent in GC per second of wall clock (pause-time fraction). A rising line is time the application is paused for GC; the metric to watch when tuning heap size against the container limit (RFC-0001 D2).

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate by Status
panels.description: sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count[5m])) by (status) -- Micrometer's server-side request rate. Mostly /healthz, /readyz, /metrics probe traffic plus the /reports job API (POST create, GET status, GET download).

panels.title: HTTP Request Latency p95
panels.description: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) -- 95th-percentile server request latency. Buckets are published via management.metrics.distribution.percentiles-histogram (application.yml).

options.content: The report engine's custom Micrometer meters. Each job POSTed to `/reports` runs on a bounded dispatcher; the bursty POI/PDF allocation it does is what drives the Heap/GC panels above into the sawtooth. Empty until reports are generated (e.g. the loadgen report scenario in PR-3, or a manual `POST /reports`).

panels.title: Report Jobs by Status
panels.description: sum(rate(reports_jobs_completed_total[5m])) by (status) -- completed report jobs per second, split by terminal status (succeeded/failed). The failed line rising is the signal a report upstream (backend) or renderer is broken.

panels.title: Report Job Duration p95
panels.description: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(reports_job_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) -- 95th-percentile end-to-end job duration (upstream fetch + render + artifact write). Buckets published via management.metrics.distribution.percentiles-histogram (application.yml).

panels.title: In-flight Report Jobs
panels.description: reports_jobs_inflight -- jobs currently rendering on the bounded dispatcher. Capped at reports.job-concurrency (application.yml); sustained saturation at the cap means jobs are queueing, the deliberate bounded-concurrency exhibit (RFC-0001 D2).

panels.title: Artifact Throughput
panels.description: sum(rate(reports_artifact_bytes_sum[5m])) -- bytes of report artifact written per second to the artifact volume. reports_artifact_bytes_count tracks the number of artifacts; artifacts live on the named volume, never in the DB (RFC-0001 D2).
